headline: BSE Index Services Launches 14 New Sectoral Indices, Takes Total Count To 20
Bajaj Finance shares close 3% higher amid Rs 11,700 crore QIP issue at floor price Rs 992.25
Dr. Reddy's bags tentative USFDA nod for twice-yearly HIV injectable lenacapavir across 120 nations
Royal Enfield unveils Himalayan 750, Continental GT 750, expands premium motorcycle portfolio at EICMA 2026
Larsen & Toubro wins significant orders for residential and commercial projects (Rs 1,000-2,500 crore band)
SBI deepens partnership with IFC, secures USD 150 mn social loan to empower 8.64 lakh rural women
note: Includes first cross-currency swap under new ISDA Master Agreement, making SBI IFC's first domestic swap counterparty in India

headline: Cholamandalam Investment seeks shareholder approval for Rs 5,000 crore QIP
note: Shareholder e-voting window Nov 10 - Dec 9, 2026; not yet finalized

headline: GAIL and KRIBHCO sign MoU to explore 1.27 MMTPA gas-based urea plant in Andhra Pradesh
note: Exploratory MoU for a new gas-based urea JV in AP; no gas volumes, financing, or ownership structure disclosed yet.

headline: HDFC Mutual Fund opens H-SIF Hybrid Long-Short Fund NFO, its first Specialized Investment Fund (SIF) product
note: Marks HDFC AMC's entry into the new SIF regulatory category; NFO window Nov 13-27, 2026.

headline: LTM (LTIMindtree) secures strategic two-year engagement worth up to $100 million with a large global banking and financial services firm
note: Deal value is a ceiling (up to $100 million), not a committed figure; client not named.

headline: BHEL bags four orders from Adani Power worth Rs 20,000-28,000 crore for 6,400 MW of ultra-supercritical thermal power projects
note: One of BHEL's largest single order announcements in recent years; four 2x800 MW projects.

headline: BHEL secures Rs 600-900 crore order from Power Grid for synchronous condensers at Barmer-II HVDC station, Rajasthan
TVS Motor expands Brazil operations, opens first flagship store in Sao Paulo, plans to raise Brazil capacity to 1.3 lakh units by 2027 with Mottu partnership
note: Part of broader international push alongside EICMA 2026 Europe launches and Mauritius distribution deal, which were excluded as less material.

headline: GMR Group unveils 500-acre aviation and aerospace hub adjacent to Bhogapuram Airport, Andhra Pradesh
note: Announced by Chairman G M Rao at the 31st CII Partnership Summit; no investment figure or completion timeline disclosed, treated as a plan rather than a firm commitment.

headline: Hexaware named strategic technology partner by EBRD under a five-year Strategic Partner Framework
note: Confirmed via exchange filing; framework covers EBRD's Run-Change-Transform technology portfolio over 5 years.

headline: Gujarat Fluorochemicals incorporates new wholly-owned subsidiary GFCL EV Critical Minerals to expand into battery chemicals/EV value chain
note: Subsidiary incorporation already completed, aimed at the EV/battery-chemicals value chain.

headline: Temasek affiliate (Jongsong Investments) to invest Rs 2,500 crore in Godrej Capital, valuing it at up to Rs 28,000 crore
note: Deal still needs regulatory approvals. Stock surged ~11.9% on the news. Capital goes into subsidiary Godrej Capital, not the parent's own balance sheet.

headline: Linde India signs SPA to acquire 100% of Airtech Cryogenic Gases for Rs 111.20 crore
note: Share purchase agreement signed same day; completion expected in ~8 weeks. Adds an air-separation unit in Dholka, Gujarat.

headline: Marico raises stake in Cosmix Wellness from 60% to 80% for Rs 113.65 crore cash
note: Board-approved, cash-paid stake increase; retains option on remaining 20% after FY29.

headline: Meesho completes acquisition of 92.74% stake in Kirana Club and Retail Pulse Labs for Rs 186.71 crore
note: Both tranches of the deal closed in cash; expands Meesho into kirana-retailer tech adjacency.

headline: RBI grants in-principle approval for Paytm Payments Services Ltd to operate wallets/prepaid payment instruments
note: In-principle nod only; final authorisation still needs system/cybersecurity audits within 6 months per RBI terms. Stock hit an all-time high on this news.
